mapper.sql: id, company_id, job_id, candidate_id, score, reason, computed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_hr_match_score (id, company_id, job_id, candidate_id, score, reason, computed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{score}, #{reason}, #{computedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), reason = VALUES(reason), computed_at = VALUES(computed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM opc_hr_match_score WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY computed_at DESC
